diagnosis.code_finding: Portal hole brushes store a -7000000 cm hole sentinel in the terrain height cache. The ocean decodes this as ordinary negative terrain height; shallow weighting therefore treats portal holes as deep water and allows full waves even with attenuation 1.0. The separate floor static mesh is not sampled as terrain.
